title: Agency as a New Organizing Abstraction for Computer Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.17410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Advances in large-scale machine learning have enabled agentic AI systems: persistent, autonomous computational entities that pursue goals, initiate actions, and interact with open environments. These systems are often framed as applications of foundation models. We argue that this framing is incomplete: agency is also a candidate new organizing abstraction for computer science. What is new is not the concept of an agent, nor runtime policy generation per se, but its general-purpose, open-ended form, in which systems can synthesize courses of action from goals, observations, and memory, over tools and environments for which no complete task-specific model was specified in advance. Thus agency becomes a systems-level abstraction as well as an AI modeling concept. translated_title: 代理性：计算机科学的一种新组织抽象
translated_abstract: 大规模机器学习的进展催生了代理式AI系统：持久的、自主的计算实体，它们能够追求目标、发起行动并与开放环境交互。这些系统通常被框定为基础模型的应用。我们认为这种框定是不完整的：代理性也是计算机科学的一个候选的新组织抽象。新的并不是智能体的概念，也不是运行时策略生成本身，而是其通用的、开放式的形式——在这种形式中，系统能够从目标、观察和记忆中综合出行动路线，作用于那些事先未指定完整任务特定模型的工具和环境。因此，代理性既成为一个系统级抽象，也成为一个人工智能建模概念。进程抽象围绕执行程序来组织计算，而代理性则围绕在有界资源下追求目标来组织计算：进程执行程序；而[原文在此处截断]
tldr: 本文提出“代理性”不仅仅是基础模型的应用，更应被视为计算机科学的一种新的组织抽象——正如“进程”抽象围绕程序执行来组织计算，“代理性”则围绕在有限资源下追求目标来组织计算。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that agency is not merely an application of foundation models but a candidate new organizing abstraction for computer science—just as the process abstraction organizes computation around executing programs, agency organizes it around pursuing goals under bounded resources.
